# Package `unicode/utf8`

```go
package utf8
```

Package utf8 implements functions and constants to support text encoded in UTF-8. It includes functions to translate between runes and UTF-8 byte sequences. See [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/UTF-8](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/UTF-8)

## Functions

### func AppendRune

```go
func AppendRune(p []byte, r rune) []byte
```

AppendRune appends the UTF-8 encoding of r to the end of p and returns the extended buffer. If the rune is out of range, it appends the encoding of [RuneError](utf8.md#const-runeerror).

### func DecodeLastRune

```go
func DecodeLastRune(p []byte) (rune, int)
```

DecodeLastRune unpacks the last UTF-8 encoding in p and returns the rune and its width in bytes. If p is empty it returns (RuneError, 0). Otherwise, if the encoding is invalid, it returns (RuneError, 1).

### func DecodeLastRuneInString

```go
func DecodeLastRuneInString(s string) (rune, int)
```

DecodeLastRuneInString is like DecodeLastRune but its input is a string.

### func DecodeRune

```go
func DecodeRune(p []byte) (rune, int)
```

DecodeRune unpacks the first UTF-8 encoding in p and returns the rune and its width in bytes. If p is empty it returns ([RuneError](utf8.md#const-runeerror), 0). Otherwise, if the encoding is invalid, it returns (RuneError, 1). Both are impossible results for correct, non-empty UTF-8.

An encoding is invalid if it is incorrect UTF-8, encodes a rune that is out of range, or is not the shortest possible UTF-8 encoding for the value. No other validation is performed.

### func DecodeRuneInString

```go
func DecodeRuneInString(s string) (rune, int)
```

DecodeRuneInString is like [DecodeRune](utf8.md#func-decoderune) but its input is a string. If s is empty it returns ([RuneError](utf8.md#const-runeerror), 0). Otherwise, if the encoding is invalid, it returns (RuneError, 1). Both are impossible results for correct, non-empty UTF-8.

An encoding is invalid if it is incorrect UTF-8, encodes a rune that is out of range, or is not the shortest possible UTF-8 encoding for the value. No other validation is performed.

### func EncodeRune

```go
func EncodeRune(p []byte, r rune) int
```

EncodeRune writes into p (which must be large enough) the UTF-8 encoding of the rune. If the rune is out of range, it writes the encoding of [RuneError](utf8.md#const-runeerror). It returns the number of bytes written.

### func FullRune

```go
func FullRune(p []byte) bool
```

FullRune reports whether the bytes in p begin with a full UTF-8 encoding of a rune. An invalid encoding is considered a full Rune since it will convert as a width-1 error rune.

### func FullRuneInString

```go
func FullRuneInString(s string) bool
```

FullRuneInString is like FullRune but its input is a string.

### func RuneCount

```go
func RuneCount(p []byte) int
```

RuneCount returns the number of runes in p. Erroneous and short encodings are treated as single runes of width 1 byte.

### func RuneCountInString

```go
func RuneCountInString(s string) int
```

RuneCountInString is like [RuneCount](utf8.md#func-runecount) but its input is a string.

### func RuneLen

```go
func RuneLen(r rune) int
```

RuneLen returns the number of bytes in the UTF-8 encoding of the rune. It returns -1 if the rune is not a valid value to encode in UTF-8.

### func RuneStart

```go
func RuneStart(b byte) bool
```

RuneStart reports whether the byte could be the first byte of an encoded, possibly invalid rune. Second and subsequent bytes always have the top two bits set to 10.

### func Valid

```go
func Valid(p []byte) bool
```

Valid reports whether p consists entirely of valid UTF-8-encoded runes.

### func ValidRune

```go
func ValidRune(r rune) bool
```

ValidRune reports whether r can be legally encoded as UTF-8. Code points that are out of range or a surrogate half are illegal.

### func ValidString

```go
func ValidString(s string) bool
```

ValidString reports whether s consists entirely of valid UTF-8-encoded runes.
